newsitem.title: USA: Concord to acquire Our Town USA Inc.
newsitem.headline: Concord to acquire Our Town USA Inc.

text.p: Concord International Group Inc delivered a strategic letter of intent on Monday to acquire controlling interests of Our Town USA Inc, a privately-held Florida corporation.

Concord International focuses on marketing emerging public companies and provides financial, communication as well as multi-media marketing strategies. Our Town USA maintains multiple Internet servers with Internet directories in some 500 cities throughout the U.S.
